song_sp_destroyer.title: Destr0yer
designNotes: TEST ONLY
V7 state machine retained; audio is embedded as lazy-decoded Blob URLs for mobile/local-file reliability; no external BGM files required.
V7 StateMachine: BOOT / LOADING(app|song) / MENU / SELECT / PLAYING / PAUSED(reason) / RESULT / ERROR_FATAL.
GameClock is the only gameplay logic time source; Audio is the physical reference with 500ms drift checks.
Source-audio timing retained; note density reduced from HARD-INTERACTION-01.
Per-song gimmick sections are authored independently; no uniform lane spam.
4K交替楼梯
6K跨手交叉
8K镜像外扩→内收
6K反向楼梯
Short-gap doubles/triples are limited to source chord events; no blind note multiplication.
Hold path occupancy remains blocked for nearby taps.
6K/8K density and difficulty reduced for readability; 4K section retained as the stronger opening gimmick.
Sliding holds reserve their occupied lane corridor for the full duration; conflicting taps are removed with a small visual safety margin.
No tap is allowed to sit on a moving hold path during 6K/8K sections.
Lane-count changes morph the actual 3D track geometry without a 4K/6K/8K popup; single-lane and sliding holds reserve their full occupied corridor and remove conflicting taps.
V9 note layer migrated from per-note DOM elements to a single Canvas renderer; tap, hold body, moving path, hold head and density ticks are drawn in one frame.

V9.1 precomputes hold Catmull-Rom samples at note creation, reuses normalized path/tick caches during gameplay, and batches steady-state Hold/Tick/Tap drawing into grouped Path2D passes to reduce per-note Canvas state changes. V9.2 removes unused synthesized-BGM code paths and V10.1 hardens mobile/local-file audio playback with embedded lazy Blob audio. V10.2 removes delayed audio start, primes media during the song-selection gesture, clamps prelude lane lookup, clears key-rebind state on navigation, adds AUTO-used tracking, uses lane-specific default keyboard layouts, and restores UI on state-hook rollback. V10 centralizes short SFX creation in AudioEngine._voice() with preset-driven envelopes; gameplay audio call sites no longer duplicate WebAudio construction logic. V10.3 replaces HTMLAudioElement BGM with AudioContext/AudioBuffer scheduling, async embedded MP3 decoding, output-timestamp-based physical position sampling, and context-state interruption recovery; GameClock remains the sole logical time source. V9.3 removes stale Canvas aliases/visual-hold flags, uses the interpolated visual perspective for judgement effects, and guards checkEnd by PLAYING state.
